auszuege.business: Hon. Precision, Inc. engages in the manufacture and sale of machinery and related components, automatic control equipment engineering, and machinery installations in Taiwan. The company provides automated test sorting machines and related visual AOI/AI computing processing, normal/high/low temperature control, down force, bar code, network, communication, and database products. It also offers handlers, such as the final test, system-level test, flash test, dynamic random access memory test, automatic optical inspection, and micro-electro-mechanical systems test handler; temperature control solution; laboratory development equipment; and burn-in ovens. The company was founded in 1999 and is headquartered in Taichung, Taiwan.
